name: B10-0330/2025 (Renew) – Tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the European Commission to act on China's export restrictions on rare earths and other critical raw materials. It asks for countermeasures, talks with China, faster permits for European mining and recycling projects, funding, stockpiles, and buying more from trusted partners. It also condemns China's restrictions and warns that sharing details with Chinese authorities could expose security secrets.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** EU car, defence, tech and green-energy industries relying on Chinese materials.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act; the resolution goes to EU governments and China.
